scope: Zombie Boss Remaining live one-second UI countdown without rescanning
rootCause: The existing one-second Map Data currentTime effect included Monster but omitted zombie_boss, so stored absolute shield deadlines were correct while the Zombie Boss table rendered against a frozen currentTime value.
fix: Zombie Boss now participates in the same one-second currentTime interval as Monster and the other time-sensitive result tabs.
privacy: Aggregate-only evidence; no live UUIDs, coordinates, account identifiers, player identities, profile identifiers, session identifiers, challenge identifiers, logs, databases, or raw live records retained.
